text:
Maria: starting EU change window now. rolling embed-service v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0 canary. tagging eng-platform + eng-oncall. deploybot will shift in ~5m
DeployBot: DeployBot scheduled: embed-service v1.5.0 canary 10% -> 30%. CI green. details: https://ci.redwood/runs/1234
Ashok: quick ask — can we enable p95 smoothing? yesterday's noise tripped alarms during low load. recommend 3m smoothing window
Kevin: +1 to smoothing. also propose sampling traces down to 5% for the canary so dashboards stay responsive
Jules: no objections, flipping sampling now (ETA ~30s)
Jules: ```curl -X POST https://opsapi.redwood/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS' -d '{"service":"embed-service","trace_sampling":0.05}'```
OpsBot: OpsBot: flag updated: embed-service trace_sampling=0.05 (eu-west)
Maria: observability playbook for this roll: if p95 > 450ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> pause rollout and pin to v1.4.2. record reason in release notes and notify infra
Ashok: prefer manual rollback unless 5xx > 2%. auto-pause ok for lower thresholds but keep humans in loop for full revert
Kevin: will add watch rules: p95>450ms (3m) -> alert #eng-oncall (no auto-rollback). 5xx > 1.5% for 2m -> auto-pause canary and tag oncall
DeployBot: DeployBot: starting shift... traffic now ~30% -> metrics: https://dashboards.redwood/s/embeds?range=5m
Maria: seeing a small p95 bump (~10ms) around t=now, looks like batchbackfill causing increased tail. watching
Ashok: 5xx at 0.02% currently, within expected. continuing
Jules: planned ramp to 60% in 10m. I'll be on watch for the next 20m
Maria: if we pin, name it "pin v1.4.2-2026-03-21" and include trace ids + sample user requests in the release notes
Kevin: snapshot posted: https://dashboards.redwood/snapshot/abc123 (permalink for post-mortem)
DeployBot: DeployBot: scheduled ramp to 60% at 4657890720 (no cancel requested)
Maria: thanks — keep replies concise. ping @eng-oncall immediately if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:
